02-heating-service-observation.txt
↗
On 2025-02-21 at07:30, a calibrated digital instrument (calibration check2024-12-15, uncertainty±0.2C) measured the living room at15.8C after overnight normal operation. Main living rooms stayed15.5–16.3C in the seven-day logger record. Resets restore heat briefly; the pump cuts out repeatedly. The fixed circulation pump has an internal bearing/control failure; it is part of landlord-maintained equipment, outside ordinary small tenant maintenance. Normal ventilation and unobstructed radiators were observed; no tenant alteration or misuse explains the failure.
What this shows

The dated calibrated observation identifies the fixed-pump fault and its causal limits.
